durationMethod: Read Playwright Running N tests using 1 worker and final passed (Xm) lines; separately subtracted their UTC log timestamps. The timestamp intervals are exact to log precision; the displayed Playwright durations are rounded to 0.1 minute.

The 90-case Mac/Linux difference is consistent with Mac running the fourth WebKit project; it is not a timing comparison because the runners and project sets differ.
